import json, os, subprocess, tempfile, pty, errno
from pathlib import Path
from kctx.config import write_config
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='kctx-ui-smoke-') as temporary:
    root = Path(temporary)
    kb = root/'kb'; kb.mkdir()
    config = write_config(root/'config.toml', root=str(kb), log_dir=str(root/'logs'))
    environment = {**os.environ, 'KCTX_CONFIG':str(config), 'TERM':'xterm-256color'}
    def run(*args, expected=0):
        result = subprocess.run(['kctx', *args], env=environment, capture_output=True, text=True)
        assert result.returncode == expected, (args,result.stdout,result.stderr)
        return result
    for args in [('--json','unknown-command'),('--json','--unknown-option'),('--json','asset','add')]:
        result=run(*args,expected=1)
        assert json.loads(result.stdout)['error']=='malformed'
        assert result.stderr=='' and '\x1b' not in result.stdout
    made=json.loads(run('--json','cite','make','web','url=https://example.test','q=Reference').stdout)
    assert json.loads(run('--json','cite','check','--line',made['line']).stdout)['results'][0]['status']=='fresh'
    run('--json','asset','add','--kind','service','--id','service-demo','--name','[bold]Demo[/bold]')
    master, slave=pty.openpty()
    process=subprocess.Popen(['kctx','--color','always','asset','list'],env=environment,stdout=slave,stderr=slave)
    os.close(slave)
    chunks=[]
    try:
        while True:
            try: data=os.read(master,65536)
            except OSError as error:
                if error.errno==errno.EIO: break
                raise
            if not data: break
            chunks.append(data)
    finally: os.close(master)
    assert process.wait()==0
    terminal=b''.join(chunks).decode()
    assert '\x1b[' in terminal and '[bold]Demo[/bold]' in terminal
    print('TTY RESULT\n'+terminal)
    frames=[{'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':1,'method':'initialize','params':{'protocol_version':'1'}}, {'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':2,'method':'cite.make','params':{'citation':{'kind':'web','fields':{'url':'https://example.test','q':'Reference'}}}}, {'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':3,'method':'shutdown'}]
    process=subprocess.run(['kctx','serve'],input='\n'.join(json.dumps(frame) for frame in frames)+'\n',env=environment,capture_output=True,text=True)
    assert process.returncode==0,(process.stdout,process.stderr)
    replies=[json.loads(line) for line in process.stdout.splitlines()]
    assert [reply['id'] for reply in replies]==[1,2,3]
    assert 'knowledge.admit' in replies[0]['result']['methods']
    assert 'https://example.test' in replies[1]['result']['payload']['line']
    assert process.stderr==''
    print('CLI_UI_SMOKE_OK: TTY result; literal markup; JSON parse errors; bundled citation; unified stdio initialize/make/shutdown')

streams.script:
import json, os, subprocess, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from kctx.config import write_config
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
 root=Path(directory); config=write_config(root/'config.toml',root=str(root),log_dir=str(root/'logs'))
 environment={**os.environ,'KCTX_CONFIG':str(config),'NO_COLOR':'1'}
 note=root/'note.md'; note.write_text('repo@main:src/example.py\n')
 human=subprocess.run(['kctx','cite','check',str(note)],env=environment,text=True,capture_output=True)
 assert human.returncode==0,(human.stdout,human.stderr)
 assert 'warning[W101]' in human.stderr and 'warning[W101]' not in human.stdout
 machine=subprocess.run(['kctx','--json','--verbose','cite','check',str(note)],env=environment,text=True,capture_output=True)
 assert machine.returncode==0 and len(json.loads(machine.stdout)['warnings'])==1 and machine.stderr==''
 logs=subprocess.run(['kctx','--json','logs'],env=environment,text=True,capture_output=True)
 events=json.loads(logs.stdout)
 assert logs.returncode==0 and [event['event'] for event in events]==['command.start','command.end']
 assert events[-1]['exit_code']==0 and len({event['run_id'] for event in events})==1
 config.write_text('unknown_setting = "bad"\n')
 failed=subprocess.run(['kctx','serve'],env=environment,text=True,input='',capture_output=True)
 assert failed.returncode==1 and failed.stderr==''
 assert json.loads(failed.stdout)['error']['data']['category']=='malformed'
 print('STREAM_SMOKE_OK: human warning stderr; JSON+verbose clean; correlated JSONL command receipt; JSONRPC startup failure')

help_color.script:
import errno, os, pty, subprocess
base={**os.environ,'TERM':'xterm-256color','NO_COLOR':'1'}
forced=subprocess.run(['kctx','--color','always','--help'],env=base,text=True,capture_output=True)
assert forced.returncode==0 and '\x1b[' in forced.stdout
plain=subprocess.run(['kctx','--color','auto','--help'],env=base,text=True,capture_output=True)
assert plain.returncode==0 and '\x1b' not in plain.stdout
master,slave=pty.openpty()
environment=dict(base);environment.pop('NO_COLOR')
process=subprocess.Popen(['kctx','--color','never','--help'],env=environment,stdout=slave,stderr=slave)
os.close(slave);pieces=[]
try:
 while True:
  try: data=os.read(master,65536)
  except OSError as error:
   if error.errno==errno.EIO: break
   raise
  if not data: break
  pieces.append(data)
finally: os.close(master)
assert process.wait()==0 and b'\x1b' not in b''.join(pieces)
invalid=subprocess.run(['kctx','--json','--color','invalid','asset','list'],env=base,text=True,capture_output=True)
import json
assert invalid.returncode==1 and json.loads(invalid.stdout)['error']=='malformed' and invalid.stderr==''
print('HELP_COLOR_OK: explicit always on pipe and NO_COLOR; auto honors NO_COLOR; explicit never in real PTY; invalid color remains JSON')
